symptoms.symptom: Short spray and delay after pushing the Start button

causes.label: Lid was opened and closed between cycle selection and start
remedies: This is normal.
See START-UP SEQUENCE in the Safety Instructions section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Lid was opened and closed between cycle selection and start"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Water may not cover the top level of the clothes.
This is normal for this high efficiency washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "This is normal"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer and the water faucets.
Clean both the hose screens (if so equipped) and the screens in the machine using a brush or a toothpick.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
Check to ensure there are no leaks at the connections.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: Drain standpipe is too low or hose too far into standpipe
remedies: The drain hose must exceed 30” height at some point between the washer back and the drain pipe.
Use anti-siphon clip.
See the Installation Instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 23: "Drain standpipe is too low or hose too far into standpipe"

remedies: Try less detergent.

causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at faucets and rubber washers are installed.
Make sure end of drain hose is correctly inserted in and secured to drain facility.

symptoms.symptom: Washer spins and pauses at the beginning of cycles

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: The washer is sensing the load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "This is normal"

causes.label: The Soak Option was chosen
remedies: This is normal.
The washer alternates between agitate and soak during these cycles to get your clothes cleaner with less wear.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "The Soak Option was chosen"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Many cycles incorporate as series of soaks within the agitation period to get your clothes clean with less wear.

symptoms.symptom: Laundry additives dispensing too soon (Dispensers on some models)

causes.label: Overfilling of dispensers
remedies: Do not overfill or add water to dispenser.
Select Deep Rinse/Extra Rinse option when using fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Overfilling of dispensers"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: The washer may pause during the spin cycle to remove soapy water more efficiently.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "This is normal"

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Washer is unplugged"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Lid is open—safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up
remedies: Close lid and press Start.

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have a separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown"

causes.label: Electronics need to be reset
remedies: Unplug washer, wait 2 minutes, plug back in and press Start.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Electronics need to be reset"

causes.label: Start was not pressed
remedies: Press Start.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Start was not pressed"

causes.label: Laundry detergent packet placed in dispenser
remedies: Laundry detergent packets should not be used in the dispensers.
They should only be added directly to the wash basket following the manufacturer’s directions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Laundry detergent packet placed in dispenser"

causes.label: Changing options (on some models)
remedies: This is normal.
Several options will change other options to maximize washer performance.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Changing options (on some models)"

causes.label: Basket moves or rotates freely
remedies: Washer basket does not have a traditional brake.
Washer basket will move freely.
This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Basket moves or rotates freely"

causes.label: Agitator top moves/has side-to-side movement
remedies: Agitator top is designed to be flexible to allow for care of large bulky items such as comforters; this is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Agitator top moves/has side-to-side movement"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
Make sure you have selected the Deep Rinse/Extra Rinse option.
(on some models) Pretreat stain and rewash using Speed Wash cycle before drying.
(on some models)
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort whites or lightly colored items from dark colors.

causes.label: Detergent amount

causes.label: Hard water

causes.label: Water is not hot enough
remedies: Make sure water heater is delivering water at 120°F–140°F (48°C–60°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Water is not hot enough"

causes.label: Washer is overloaded
remedies: Loosely load clothes no higher than the top row of holes in the washer basket.
For best results, load items around the outside of the basket.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Washer is overloaded"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort clothes by color.
If fabric label states wash separately, unstable dyes may be indicated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Clothes are air or line dried
remedies: If you do not dry your clothes with a clothes dryer, your clothes may retain more lint.

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Incorrect sorting"

causes.label: Washing too long
remedies: Wash small loads for a shorter time using Light Soil setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Washing too long"

causes.label: Detergent not dissolving
remedies: Rewash; next time: Try a liquid detergent Use warmer water temperature.

causes.label: Overloading

For best results, load items around the outside of the basket.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Overloading"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener

Make sure you have selected the Deep Rinse/Extra Rinse option.

causes.label: Incorrect cycle selected
remedies: Make sure the cycle selected matches the load you are washing.
Some fabrics will feel wetter when rinsed with cold water.

symptoms.symptom: Blinking Spin light or Spin light on at end of cycle

remedies: Allow cycle to continue and finish.
If load is wet at the end of the cycle, even out load and run a Drain & Spin cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Out of balance condition has been detected"

causes.label: Result of normal wear on poly-cotton blends and fuzzy fabrics
remedies: While this is not caused by the washer, you can slow the pilling process by washing garments inside out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Result of normal wear on poly-cotton blends and fuzzy fabrics"

symptoms.symptom: Snags, holes, tears, rips or excessive wear

causes.label: Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers and sharp objects left in pockets
remedies: Fasten snaps, hooks, buttons and zippers.
Remove loose items like pins, objects in pockets and sharp buttons.
Turn knits (which snag easily) inside out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers and sharp objects left in pockets"

causes.label: Undiluted chlorine bleach
remedies: Check bleach package instructions for proper amount.
Never add undiluted bleach to wash or allow clothes to come in contact with undiluted bleach.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Undiluted chlorine bleach"

causes.label: Chemicals like hair bleach or dye, permanent wave solution

causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Chemicals like hair bleach or dye, permanent wave solution"

causes.label: Incorrect wash and dry cycles
remedies: Match Cycle selection to the type of fabric you are washing (especially for easy care loads).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Incorrect wash and dry cycles"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Avoid mixing heavy items (like jeans) with light items (like blouses).
Try a fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Improper sorting"

remedies: Loosely load clothes in the washer basket.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 25: "Overloading"
